title: Mean-reversion analytics — z-score to 20/50/200-bar MAs, Ornstein-Uhlenbeck half
description: Mean-reversion analytics — z-score to 20/50/200-bar MAs, Ornstein-Uhlenbeck half-life in days (AR(1) regression on log prices), reversion probability (2-sided normal CDF). Identifies coins stretched from equilibrium and speed of mean reversion. Informational research data — not investment advice.
